titleEn: Cargill announces $130 million investment for poultry operations in Thailand, Philippines
titleZh: 嘉吉宣布投资1.3亿美元扩建泰国和菲律宾禽肉业务
summaryZh: 嘉吉宣布未来两年投资超1.3亿美元，扩建泰国和菲律宾的禽肉业务，重点提升供应链韧性、食品安全和质量创新能力。核心项目包括泰国Saraburi工厂新建自动化熟鸡肉生产线（预计2028年完工）、引入AI数据处理、新建3万吨谷物筒仓，以及菲律宾新建年产19万吨饲料厂。扩建后嘉吉熟鸡肉总产能预计达约16万吨，为泰国创造25亿泰铢出口值和300多个就业岗位。
featuredReason: 该新闻展示了全球农业巨头嘉吉在亚洲禽肉供应链的智能化升级布局，涉及自动化生产线、AI数据处理和饲料厂建设，对关注智慧畜牧出海、禽业自动化趋势的从业者具有重要参考价值。
contentFull:
SINGAPORE — With global protein demand continuing to rise, major agricultural company Cargill continues to look for new markets for cooked poultry products.

The company recently announced it would invest more than $130 million in the next two years to expand its poultry operations in Asia. Cargill plans to make capacity and efficiency updates across its entire poultry network in Thailand and the Philippines, with an emphasis on supply chain resilience, enhanced food safety, quality, and innovation to support foodservice and retail businesses around the world.

“Demand for high-quality protein continues to grow across global markets, and customers are looking for reliable innovation partners who can help them scale with confidence,” said Watcharapon Prasopkiatpoka, vice president and managing director of Poultry APAC at Cargill. “This investment strengthens our ability to deliver poultry products with the quality and consistency our customers need. By investing in infrastructure, technology and people, we are serving the growing demand from customers for high-quality protein, while creating long-term economic value for farmers, businesses, suppliers and local communities.”

One of the highlighted investments includes a new automated cooked chicken production line at the Cargill poultry processing plant in Saraburi, Thailand, which is expected to be completed in 2028.

At the facility, the company plans to make technological upgrades to state-of-the-art machinery and integrate artificial intelligence (AI) into its data processing. The cooked poultry products from Thailand remain a strategic poultry export hub for Japan, Europe, Asia and North America. With this expansion, Cargill’s total cooked volume is expected to increase to approximately 160,000 tonnes, generating a total of THB 25 billion ($744 million) in export value for Thailand annually and creating more than 300 jobs.

Along with the poultry production upgrades, Cargill will construct a new 30,000-tonne grain silo in Thailand to enhance raw material storage capacity and grain procurement. The facility is expected to be completed by early 2027.

For its business in the Philippines, Cargill plans to make poultry investments, including a feed mill with production capacity of 190,000 tonnes annually. The new project is expected to be completed by late 2027 and generate more than 100 jobs, according to the company.

Cargill also plans to expand its network of hatcheries, breeder and broiler farms to work on supply and cost efficiencies to better serve domestic foodservice customers.
translationZh:
随着全球蛋白质需求持续上升，大型农业公司嘉吉继续为熟禽肉产品寻找新市场。

该公司近日宣布，将在未来两年内投资超过1.3亿美元，以扩大其在亚洲的禽肉业务。嘉吉计划对其在泰国和菲律宾的整个禽肉网络进行产能和效率升级，重点聚焦供应链韧性、食品安全提升、质量与创新，以支持全球餐饮服务和零售业务。

嘉吉亚太区禽肉业务副总裁兼董事总经理Watcharapon Prasopkiatpoka表示：“全球市场对高质量蛋白质的需求持续增长，客户正在寻找可靠的创新合作伙伴，帮助他们有信心地扩大规模。这项投资增强了我们交付客户所需质量和一致性禽肉产品的能力。通过投资基础设施、技术和人员，我们正在满足客户对高质量蛋白质日益增长的需求，同时为农民、企业、供应商和当地社区创造长期经济价值。”

重点投资之一包括在嘉吉位于泰国北标府的禽肉加工厂新建一条自动化熟鸡肉生产线，预计将于2028年完工。

在该工厂，公司计划对先进机械进行技术升级，并将人工智能（AI）整合到数据处理中。来自泰国的熟禽肉产品仍然是面向日本、欧洲、亚洲和北美的战略禽肉出口枢纽。通过此次扩建，嘉吉的熟肉总产量预计将增至约16万吨，每年为泰国创造总计250亿泰铢（约7.44亿美元）的出口值，并创造300多个就业岗位。

除了禽肉生产升级外，嘉吉还将在泰国新建一座3万吨谷物筒仓，以增强原材料储存能力和谷物采购。该设施预计将于2027年初完工。

在菲律宾业务方面，嘉吉计划进行禽肉投资，包括建设一座年产能19万吨的饲料厂。据该公司称，该项目预计将于2027年底完工，并创造100多个就业岗位。

嘉吉还计划扩大其孵化场、种鸡场和肉鸡养殖场网络，以提高供应和成本效率，更好地服务国内餐饮服务客户。
